root_cause.text: In `l2cap_sock_ready_cb`, the function dereferences `chan->data` to obtain a `sock` pointer without checking if it is NULL, leading to a null-pointer dereference when the socket has been freed or not assigned.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!sk) return;` before calling `lock_sock(sk)`; the crash backtrace shows the null-ptr-deref occurs at `lock_sock_nested` called from `l2cap_sock_ready_cb`.
